messages:
maria: Quick sync: after the weekend incidents we need a deterministic policy for composing claims from multiple layers. Current union behavior caused accidental elevation.
jonathan: Repro: client -> edge (client_claims) -> ingress (tenant_claims) -> operator-sidecar (operator_hints) -> service. Mapping currently unions everything.
li: Unioning is unsafe. Suggest model: 1) deny-overrides for conflicting high-priv roles, 2) weighted precedence for permits, 3) specificity tiebreaker (project id > wildcard).
alex: Define trust weights: service=100, operator=80, edge=50, client=10. Pick highest; if tie, higher specificity wins.
maria: Require provenance fields on claims: role, scope, source, stamp_id. Missing stamp_id -> treated as untrusted.
patrick: Ops metrics we need: claim_conflict_rate, conflict_denied_total, precedence_overrides_total, sampled_conflict_payloads (0.1%).
jonathan: Pseudo:
```
group claims by (role,scope)
if any.claim.deny == true -> deny
else pick max(trust_weight + specificity)
```
Specificity: project_id=2, wildcard=1.
li: Edge-case: client-sent specific project should NOT outrank operator wildcard. Cap untrusted claims at 20.
alex: Hard cap claims per request (200); if exceeded, trim lowest-trust or fail-closed.
maria: Migration: week0 shadow logs; week1 ff canary (5%); week2 25% + chaos; week3 rollout + 90d enhanced audit retention. Gating: <0.05% 4xx/5xx delta.
jonathan: I'll own the shadow-logging PR.
patrick: I'll wire grafana + alerts.
li: I'll add unit/integration tests and fuzz harness.
sec-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/issues/517 "claims-combining-algo-deny-overrides-and-provenance-envelope".
maria: Drop incident repros into the issue labeled incident-402. We'll review after shadow week.
